name: void-dominion-mobile
description: Capacitor Android wrapper that packages the Void Dominion prototype (a self-contained HTML game) into an installable APK. Standalone — not part of the pnpm workspace.

scripts.brand: npm run assets && node patch-android.mjs && node patch-updater.mjs
scripts.apk: npm run www && npm run sync && npm run brand && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-daemon
scripts.apk:player: npm run www:player && npm run sync && npm run brand && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-daemon

comments.overrides: Pin the transitive node-tar to a patched line (>=7.5.21) to clear the GHSA path-traversal / symlink / file-smuggling advisories (tar <=7.5.15) AND the mapHas/filesFilter uncontrolled-recursion DoS (GHSA-r292-9mhp-454m, tar <=7.5.20). We keep Capacitor 6 (the v6/JDK17 APK pipeline) instead of the breaking @capacitor/cli@8 bump. brace-expansion is pinned to 5.0.9 across the tree to clear CVE-2026-14257 / GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg — the affected 2.x line has no patched release (2.1.2 is the latest 2.x), and the 5.x line ships dual CJS/ESM (a working `require` export) with the same stable `expand()` API, so forcing it into minimatch's 1.x/2.x consumers was safe (since 2026-10-31 the only consumer is minimatch 11, which asks for ^5.0.12 itself). The pin moved 5.0.8 → 5.0.9 when GHSA-rgw5-rvv9-x895 landed on 5.0.8 itself, and 5.0.9 → 5.0.12 when GHSA-6j4f-fj2g-mc7p / GHSA-q2hr-2g5m-vwhr / GHSA-qhr7-859c-m2p7 landed on 5.0.9 (5.0.10–5.0.12 are the three patch releases of 2026-09-14): a pinned version is a version that stops receiving fixes, so this line has to be re-checked whenever the SCA gate goes red. minimatch and glob are forced tree-wide onto the only majors that carry the fix, because no older line got a backport: GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 / CVE-2026-118764 covers every minimatch below 11.0.1, GHSA-3g3m-2fjr-6pw4 / CVE-2026-118773 covers glob 9.0.0 to 14.0.1 (fixed in 14.0.2). glob 14 keeps glob 9/13's exported functions, so both rimraf 4 (nested @capacitor/cli 5 of @capacitor/assets) and rimraf 6 (@capacitor/cli 8) load unchanged. The tree-wide minimatch also replaces the old scoped `replace → minimatch ^3.1.4` override (replace@1.2.2 pins minimatch 3.0.5 exactly, ReDoS GHSA-23c5-xmqv-rm74 and friends). replace calls minimatch as a function, which the named-export module of minimatch 11 is not; that call is dead code here: @trapezedev/project declares replace but nothing in the tree requires or imports it (checked 2026-10-31), and if anything ever starts using it, it throws a TypeError on the first pattern instead of matching wrongly. xcode@3.0.1 wants uuid ^7.0.3 with no patched 7.x for GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq (patched in 11.1.1), so that override stays scoped to xcode. sharp is pinned above @capacitor/assets' own sharp@0.32.6: the floor moved 0.35.3 → 0.35.4 when GHSA-rgj7-g3m4-5g8c landed on 0.35.3 itself (heap overflow in the bundled libheif, RCE-capable on glibc Linux when decoding untrusted AVIF; fixed in 0.35.4), and 0.35.4 → 0.35.5 when GHSA-wq5f-xc86-pv6w / CVE-2026-96889 landed on 0.35.4 (use-after-free in the bundled librsvg when decoding SVG, same RCE-on-glibc profile; fixed in 0.35.5, which ships librsvg 2.63.2) — the same «пин перестаёт получать фиксы» trap as brace-expansion above, and the reason this line is re-checked every time the SCA gate goes red.
comments.postinstall: tar 7's CJS interop leaves `tar_1.default` undefined, so @capacitor/cli@6's `tar_1.default.extract` crashes `cap add/sync`. patch-capacitor-tar.mjs rewrites it to `(tar_1.default||tar_1).extract` (works under tar 6 and 7) after install, so the override doesn't break the build.
